approvedProducts.name: Kin Polo
approvedProducts.description: The Kin Polo reworks a classic short-sleeve polo with a relaxed, feminine silhouette. Crafted from stretch cotton piqué with a pigment garment wash, it features a structured flat-knit collar, ribbed cuffs and hem, and subtle embroidery at the chest.

approvedProducts.name: Clara Dress
approvedProducts.description: A refined knit polo dress designed with elevated texture, clean tailoring, and vintage sport influence throughout. The Clara Dress blends structured golf styling with modern femininity, featuring an engineered all-over pattern, rib knit detailing, and a sculpted silhouette that moves seamlessly between the course and everyday wear.

approvedProducts.name: Luisa Jacket
approvedProducts.description: Lightweight protection with a refined edge. The Luisa Jacket is designed to move effortlessly between performance and everyday wear—balancing clean structure with functional detail.
